scripts.build: npx tsc --noEmit && node esbuild.js && node -e "const manifest = require('./manifest.json'); const fs = require('fs'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const outputFile = `dist/${manifest.id}.wasm`; execSync(`extism-js dist/index.js -i src/index.d.ts -o ${outputFile}`, {stdio: 'inherit'}); console.log(`✅ Generated WASM: ${outputFile}`);"
